card.name: Verbs and dashes mid-sentence in caps
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as BE, IS, MORE and OTHERWISE in all-capital drug-label sentences, right after a long subject. Also an em dash that closes an aside in ordinary web prose.

modes.label: Be/is in capitalised label text
modes.description: The verb BE or IS right after a long subject or a modal like WILL or MAY, in an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: WHEN THE APPROPRIATE INFUSION SETS ARE USED, THE CALCULATED DOSE WILL<< BE>> DELIVERED TO THE PATIENT,

modes.label: Em dash after an aside
modes.description: An em dash that ends an interrupting clause in news-style prose and resumes the main sentence.
modes.example: and Keelan—claiming he was a veteran of the Civil War<<—>>was there to request his rightful payment.
